name: skill-generation
description: Skill creation, document conversion, polishing, evaluation, packaging, governance, and publishing workflows for Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: 用于从书籍和文档生成、打磨、验证并发布 Agent Skills 的方法论技能集。
interface.longDescription: Skill Generation packages LearnPrompt/luban-skill, yaojingang/yao-meta-skill, and virgiliojr94/book-to-skill for Codex. It converts books and document collections into structured, on-demand Agent Skills and helps agents audit, benchmark, create, refactor, evaluate, govern, validate, showcase, package, and publish reusable skills with explicit validation and release gates.
defaultPrompt: 把这本书或文档集转换成可复用的 Agent Skill。
让鲁班看看这个 skill，并给出打磨报告。
用 Yao Meta Skill 把这套重复流程做成可复用 skill 包。
